name: BepInEx 6 plugin (Mono)
summary: A plugin dll for Unity Mono games that run the BepInEx 6 bleeding edge builds instead of BepInEx 5.
description: A C# class library that BepInEx 6 loads from BepInEx\plugins in a Unity Mono game. Most Mono games use BepInEx 5; pick this only when the game folder has BepInEx 6 (BepInEx\core\BepInEx.Unity.Mono.dll). A BepInEx 5 plugin does not load in BepInEx 6 and the other way round.

next: Open the folder in Visual Studio, Rider or VS Code.
The dll is in bin\Release. With a game folder set it is also copied to BepInEx\plugins in the game.
Start the game and look for the plugin's line in BepInEx\LogOutput.log.
Your code starts in Plugin.cs, in Awake.
